essence: The yogini gathering in this context always grants both enjoyment and liberation.
One should fill with blood in a quantity equal to that of semen.
Blood is the left nectar, and semen is that which is mixed with wine and brahma.
The devoted great-souled one is associated with the consciousness of wine-bliss.
After placing it in a conch or vessel, one should worship it in proper order.
